description: Na₄Cr₂H₆O₁₁ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.42 Å. Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.68 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) H-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Cr, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cr atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms.
